summary.headline: FY26 revenue rose about 84% to INR189 crore and PAT 26% to INR29.14 crore, but margins compressed on construction-cost inflation and new-project start-up costs.
summary.overview: Management reported record FY26 revenue of about INR189 crore (up ~84% from INR102 crore) and EBITDA of INR38.46 crore (up 35%), with PAT of INR29.14 crore (up 26%). Margins moderated on project mix, war-related construction input inflation, and early-stage costs on newly started projects. Two projects (Rashmi Vasudev and Rashmi Celestia) received OC and were handed over during the year, and the company remains debt-free. Management guided that margins will return to prior levels in FY27 and that Rashmi Square and Rashmi Signature are the key cash-generating projects.

financial_highlights.change: up ~84% YoY from INR102 crore in FY25

financial_highlights.value: INR149 crore (as read by analyst; transcript reads 'INRS1.49 crore')
INR25,000 to INR27,000 per sq ft

segments.name: Rashmi Square
segments.commentary: Reached 19 floors; delivery planned in FY27, about 69% booked; management targets realisations of INR27,000 to 28,000 per sq ft as completion nears.

segments.name: Rashmi Signature
segments.commentary: Three 18-floor towers at 19 floors; handover targeted Q1 FY27, about 50% booked (analyst cited 57% of carpet area booked); sample flats added in Q3-Q4 to lift conversion, with a target of about 75% in Q2-Q3 FY27.

segments.name: Rashmi Delight and Rashmi Manorath
segments.commentary: Both about half complete with completion targeted next year; Rashmi Delight has seen good sales traction, while Rashmi Manorath has seen less traction and the company is adding channel partners.

segments.name: Rashmi Icon and Rashmi Avenu
segments.commentary: Started in Feb and Mar 2026 (4,500 sq m and 4,000 sq m layouts respectively) with early traction; Rashmi Avenu in Dahisar.

segments.name: Completed projects
segments.commentary: Rashmi Vasudev (Borivali West, 90 units) and Rashmi Celestia (Borivali LT Road, 81 units plus 23 commercial shops, ~10,500 sq ft) received OC and were handed over in FY26; Rashmi Kavita and Rashmi Vasudev are fully sold.

guidance_outlook: Management said blended realisations will not fall and will rise; Rashmi Square is targeted at INR27,000 to 28,000 per sq ft versus about INR25,000 earlier.
Margins expected to bounce back to previous levels in FY27 (management said EBITDA margins should be on track to the prior level).
Khar project sale-rate target INR45,000 to 50,000 per sq ft; Parla bid also in progress.
Rashmi Paradigm (spelt Paradics in transcript) expected to start execution in Q2 FY27; Rashmi Shetal and Rashmi Gold recently acquired; Govind Dalvi Nagar in pipeline/approval stage.
No new land acquisitions planned in FY27 for now; township projects outside Mumbai are being explored but no suitable land found.
No dividend under consideration; board focused on project execution.
capex_capacity: Portfolio of 24 residential and commercial projects; 12.5 lakh sq ft under construction and 9 lakh sq ft in pipeline; about 7.25 lakh sq ft delivered to date.
Six ongoing projects after Rashmi Icon and Rashmi Avenu were started in FY26.
Total portfolio of 7.5 lakh sq ft: 4.92 lakh sq ft booked and 2.40 lakh sq ft available inventory.
Rashmi Square expected delivery FY27; Rashmi Signature Q1 FY27; Rashmi Delight and Rashmi Manorath completion next year.
Company stated it is asset-light and funds internal project cash flows from high-margin Rashmi Square and Rashmi Signature; no structured debt planned for Icon or Avenu.
demand_pricing: Management reports healthy demand in Borivali, Kandivali and Dahisar with no slowdown; buyers returning from abroad and NRIs buying in India are cited as drivers.
Q3 seasonality (Shraadh period Dec to mid-Jan) cited as a slow period; management expects Q1 FY27 bookings to reflect better footfall and conversion.
Raw material cost inflation affecting only Rashmi Square and Rashmi Signature, where materials are being procured at higher prices; management said impact is limited.
Supply rising in Mumbai; management says buyers are choosier and amenity-rich projects (open play areas, children's play area) are the company's advantage.
Management said the company is targeting South Bombay (Dadar talks) and Khar and Parla in western suburbs.

qa_highlights.question: How much raw material inflation hit the company and was it passed through to realisations?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said only Rashmi Square and Rashmi Signature were hit minorly; other projects are unaffected and the overall impact is limited at the current execution stage.

qa_highlights.question: What is the blended realisation and will it rise?
qa_highlights.answer: FY26 realisation was about INR25,000 to 27,000 per sq ft; management said it will not fall and Rashmi Square is targeted at INR27,000 to 28,000.

qa_highlights.question: Why did margins decline and when will they normalise?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited construction cost inflation from the war and early-stage costs of two new projects, expecting margins to return to prior levels in FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a need for structured debt for Icon or Avenu?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said no; funding will come from internal cash flows of Rashmi Square and Rashmi Signature, and borrowings are minimal.

qa_highlights.question: Dividend policy and capital employed?
qa_highlights.answer: No dividend under consideration for now as the board prioritises projects; capital employed estimated at INR80 to 90 crore as on 31 March.

risks_watch: EBITDA margin recovery to prior levels in FY27 is management's expectation; FY26 margins fell and the cost drivers (war-related input inflation) remain open.
Rashmi Manorath has weak sales traction; company is shifting to channel partners and internal sales policies.
Rashmi Signature booking conversion (about 50% per management, analyst cited 57% of carpet area) needs to rise to the targeted ~75%.
Q4 FY26 revenue growth (analyst cited 158% YoY) and Q1 FY27 bookings are key checkpoints.
Limited new land pipeline for FY27 and difficulty finding clear-title land for township projects.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand, delivery timelines and the debt-free model, but noticeably loose on specifics: several figures were corrected or left vague (realisation, carpet-area booking, capital employed), and margin recovery was asserted without numbers.
key_quotes: We don't build walls, we build homes that creates a long-term value for families and stakeholders alike.
We are still debt-free despite rapid growth.
Our profitability growth continues to be backed by actual project execution and sales conversion, not financial engineering.

adds.what: Rashmi Icon (4,500 sq m layout) started Feb 2026, and Rashmi Avenu (4,000 sq m layout, Dahisar) started Mar 2026; both are project starts, not capacity commissi

growth.why: FY26 revenue up ~84% to INR189 crore and Q4 revenue up 158% per analyst; management guides EBITDA margins back to prior levels in FY27 and Rashmi Signature handover in Q1 FY27, with Rashmi Square delivery in FY27, backed by booked inventory (69% and ~50% booked) and new project starts but no quantified FY27 revenue target.
